title: helm(private): stabilize values templating and init-hook rollback logic
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Several customers running Redwood Private hit upgrade failures when init-hook jobs reconcile templated values (KMS/PG backups/tolerations) during chart upgrades. These issues manifested as 1) init jobs not picking up templated .Values fields after Helm post-render, 2) rollback leaving orphaned InitJob CRDs, and 3) brittle schema validation that rejected legitimate TLS/KMS permutations. This PR stabilizes the values templating and init-hook lifecycle to make upgrades and rollbacks deterministic.

Summary of changes: - Consolidate values schema for private.values to accept union-types for encryption/kms/tls blocks and document defaults. - Move init-job templating to use helm-capable template functions (include/define) and ensure rendered values are persisted to a ConfigMap consumed by init jobs at runtime. - Add explicit ownerReferences and deletionPolicy hooks on InitJob CRD manifests so rollbacks clean up jobs and associated PVCs. - Add tolerations/nodeSelector merge logic to avoid overwriting cluster defaults during templated merges. - Improve chart tests and add an integration test harness script for rollout->upgrade->rollback cycle.

Checklist: - [x] Values schema expanded and backward-compatible changes documented - [x] Init-job templates refactored to deterministic rendering using named templates - [x] Rollback cleanup via ownerReferences and hook-weighting - [x] Unit + helm template tests added - [x] Integration smoke test (local kind) added - [x] Reviewed and approved by infra/SRE

Testing notes: Ran full chart render matrix (k8s 1.24/1.25) and verified helm template/helm install -> upgrade -> rollback cycle in a local kind cluster. Integration test script reproduces previous failure case (kms empty string vs null) and now succeeds. CI initially failed due to an integration flake (postgres init job timing); added a readiness probe backoff to make the test deterministic and re-ran CI which passed.

Compatibility notes: Changes to values schema are additive and accept both string and object forms for kms/encryption blocks. Existing installs should be unaffected; customers with custom post-renderers that mutate values may need to re-run an upgrade with --reuse-values to ensure templates are re-evaluated.

Upgrade/Rollback guidance: For clusters with existing InitJob CRDs older than 2024-09-01, run the included migration job (scripts/migrate-initjobs.sh) prior to applying the chart to attach ownerReferences. The migration is idempotent and safe to run multiple times.

Related: ENG-7012, SUP-3342, previously attempted fixes in pr-88402 and pr-66642.
commits: refactor(init-hooks): move templating to named templates; chore(values): extend private.values schema for kms/encryption; fix(rollback): add ownerReference and hook-weight; test: add helm upgrade/rollback integration; docs: add migration instructions
